cars.specification_market: Original T-head Mercer Type 35 Raceabout production-road family; selected 1912 Model 35-C museum reference at Revs Institute, serial 764. All eight attributes map to the collection entry. Preserve its 300 cubic inches and 58 hp at 1700 rpm without inventing an SAE/DIN standard or exact converted displacement. Wheelbase converts 108 inches exactly to 2743.2 mm. Body/control descriptions belong to the museum reference, not authentication of every chassis. Group T-head years, 35-R/35-C/35-J naming and equipment once; later L-head models, dedicated racers, the mixed 1911/1913 Simeone car, replica bodies on Ford chassis and unrelated touring models are not additionally admitted. No gearbox count, bore/stroke, fuel-system type, torque, weight basis, speed, acceleration, production totals or universal originality claim imported.
cars.summary: The Mercer Raceabout is a defining early American production sports car: Finley Robertson Porter's minimalist T-head road design combined purposeful engineering with important early competition heritage. Its lasting identity and rivalry with the Stutz Bearcat establish significance beyond age or rarity. Count the original T-head Raceabout road family once across years and equipment; a racing result does not establish stock-road tuning.
